name: Cryska Barchenowa
original_name: クリスカ・ビャーチェノワ
source:
A TSF pilot in the Soviet Military’s Idol test unit. She pilots a multi-seater Su-37B, and her skills as a pilot far exceed anyone else’s. She and her fellow pilot, Inia, are known as the “Scarlet Twins”. She is fiercely loyal to her homeland, and cold to those around her, but her emotions towards Inia are somewhere between love and obsession.

[From [url=https://muvluv.com/en/total-eclipse]Official website[/url]]
